react.boundary: ReAct materialization is explicit, bounded, and tools=[] only.

react_v2.boundary: ReActV2 follows the DSPy 3.3 beta boundary: explicit opt-in, public dspy.ReActV2 availability, and tools=[] only.
react_v2.safe_next_action: Declare desired tools as descriptor-only capability/tool contracts first; materialize ReActV2 with tools=[] until a reviewed generated tool-adapter policy lands.
why_tools_not_enabled: DSPy 3.3 beta ReActV2 availability does not by itself define DSPx tool authority, effect, redaction, timeout, sandbox, replay, or receipt contracts.
program_tool_contracts.json is descriptor-only in this slice; no generated dspy.Tool adapter hash/provenance exists yet.
Enabling ReActV2 tools would allow external side effects unless every tool is explicitly declared, bounded, replay-visible, and policy-checked before materialization.

retrievers.boundary: Retriever materialization requires an explicit bounded Retriever topology module; external/live retrievers remain disabled.

tools.boundary: Tool declarations may be recorded, but dspy.Tool/live tool execution is not bound by program-gen.

taxonomy.label: Descriptor-only
taxonomy.meaning: Capability is represented in the normalized intent/preview evidence but is not executed.

taxonomy.label: Local dry-run/evaluation
taxonomy.meaning: Capability may be checked locally through schema/hash/preview validation without live tool, retriever, import, or authority effects.

taxonomy.label: Executable local
taxonomy.meaning: Capability may execute only inside the generated candidate's declared local runtime/evaluation boundary.

taxonomy.label: Production activation
taxonomy.meaning: Capability affects live routing, canonical state, source-owner systems, or external authority.
